claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_option_restriction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation surface can represent the shared charge pool, fixed save DC, dawn recharge, last-charge destruction, and Fear's 60-foot cone via area override. It cannot honestly express that casts of Command granted by this item are restricted to only specific command-word branches of the underlying spell.
